thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-06-03 is again dominated by generic aggregator content (retail comparisons, personal-finance listicles, recycled AI/data-center commentary, routine politician PTR filings) with no fresh, verifiable macro catalyst or broad-market signal suitable for a conservative core-ETF sleeve. The one dated, credible item (Berkshire-Taylor Morrison all-cash deal) is single-name M&A noise outside the core-ETF mandate and not actionable for capital preservation. Existing VTI core position (~21% of equity) and cash buffer (~79%, well above the 25% floor) remain unchanged; holding rather than forcing a trade on thin evidence.
